predicate same_except_at(old: list[option[int]], new: list[option[int]], idx: int, val: option[int]) {
    var n: int = len(old);
    (((len(new) == n) ∧
        (0 <= idx < n)) ==>
        (∀(i: int) ::
            ((0 <= i < n) ==>
                (((i == idx) ==>
                    (new[i] == val)) ∧
                    ((i != idx) ==>
                        (new[i] == old[i]))))))
}
